about: Live-path Smart UI evals on the Fernhollow council example (examples/smart-ui-fernhollow): a public service people use now and then. The model routes to the app's read actions (by keywords first), answers in Fernhollow's own system, and is validated against the data it got. Changes (renew, pay, book, upload) must end in an ApprovalPrompt. Invented data.
